coverage: Group reporting segments · revenue before removing internal sales
incomeDefinition: Each row includes fees earned from that business, including any fees charged within the group. The group removes those internal fees when reporting revenue from operations.
definition: The result for each business before group income that CDSL does not assign to a segment and before tax.
revenueTotalLabel: Gross segment revenue before removing internal fees
location: PDF page 287, consolidated profit and loss statement. PDF page 339, note 35, segment reporting. PDF page 154, group performance discussion.
notes: After removing ₹1.75 crore of internal fees, revenue from operations was ₹1,144.92 crore. Adding ₹89.47 crore of income not assigned to a segment brought profit before tax to ₹608.99 crore. Group profit after tax was ₹455.08 crore, of which ₹456.13 crore was attributable to CDSL shareholders. The outside shareholders’ share was a loss of ₹1.06 crore.
insight: The depository provided most operating revenue and the largest segment result. Group profit fell year on year. CDSL reported higher technology and staff costs and lower investment income.
